blocking_findings: The purported exact main literal is 39 characters and omits the final d.
The spec requires a deterministic Check Run but globally forbids checks:write creation.
Repaired main cannot install a rejection guard inside the immutable v0.6.13 tag workflow; publication authority must reject it instead.
Verifier dispatch ownership and permissions are contradictory.
PR #99 is blocked by issue #98 and both #99/#94 require post-v0.6.14 rebase and protected checks.
The tag-selected verifier executes candidate-source scripts with OIDC and registry credentials; privileged signing must execute protected-main code over immutable digest-bound outputs.
Canonical URL/check-ID binding and exact-duplicate precedence are ambiguous.
Publisher dispatch has no durable identity/receipt contract for crash-safe idempotency.
Per-workflow/job permissions are not specified as an exact matrix.
Baseline and preserved-file invariants are not executable.
Golden canonical identity and URL fixtures are missing.
filter=all pagination, ordering, ancestry, polling bounds, and fake-clock behavior are underspecified.
Retirement/manual-bypass guards are not tested at every mutation-capable entry point.
Retry/crash state, per-write revalidation, protected-check wiring, and credentialed acceptance lack exact schemas and oracles.

consensus.summary: All three independent lanes rejected v1.7. Preserve its reproduced root causes and forward-only intent, but revise the trust boundary, canonical identity, durable dispatch state, exact permissions, retirement guarantees, fixtures, and sequencing before any implementation.
